_purpose: Test external deadline pressure (NOT clock-based countdown), competing objectives under time limit, resource allocation choices, sacrifice decisions, triage mechanics, evacuation logistics, moral choice under time constraint (save who?)
_scenario_hint: Mining Station Omega-7 (void_level 8, critical breach imminent), void breach will destroy entire station in EXACTLY 10 rounds (external countdown, not scene clock). Three competing objectives: evacuate 50 civilian NPCs (requires 6 rounds), seal breach with ritual (requires 4 rounds + sacrifice of PC void score), recover critical Tempest research data (requires 3 rounds). Ship capacity: 40 NPCs maximum. Cannot achieve all objectives - must choose: maximize lives saved, preserve research, attempt risky seal (may fail and waste time), prioritize VIPs vs. random civilians. Void manifestations attack evacuation routes. Time is absolute - at round 10 END, station explodes regardless of completion.

_design_notes.ml_training_value: External deadline (10 rounds HARD limit), competing objectives impossible to all achieve, resource allocation under time pressure, sacrifice decisions (who to leave behind?), triage mechanics (VIPs vs. civilians), evacuation logistics, moral choice under time constraint, rear guard combat while evacuating, absolute consequence (failure = death)
_design_notes.character_innovation: Pilot specialist (ship operation), combat specialist (rear guard), ritualist (breach seal option), heavy weapons (Breach Hammer, Shrike Cannon), ship access chips

starting_clocks.name: Civilian Evacuation Progress

starting_clocks.regress_meaning: civilian evacuation progress setback or reversal

starting_clocks.name: Research Data Recovery
starting_clocks.description: Critical Tempest data extracted. At 3 ticks: research secured.
starting_clocks.regress_meaning: research data recovery setback or reversal

starting_clocks.name: Breach Seal Ritual Preparation
starting_clocks.description: Ritual components gathered and consecrated. At 4 ticks: ready to attempt seal (requires PC void sacrifice, 50% success chance).
starting_clocks.regress_meaning: breach seal ritual preparation setback or reversal

players.name: Pilot Commander Jex Varn
goals: Evacuate maximum civilians within ship capacity (40 max)
Decide who lives and who stays behind

players.name: Rear Guard Thresh
goals: Hold evacuation route against void manifestations
Be last one aboard (or stay behind if necessary)

players.name: Seal Ritualist Veyra Lune
goals: Attempt breach seal ritual to save station (requires sacrificing void score)
Balance seal attempt vs. evacuation time
Accept personal sacrifice if seal can save more lives

notes: ML Training Focus: External deadline (10 rounds HARD limit, not clock-based), competing objectives impossible to all achieve (evacuate 50 NPCs requires 6 rounds but ship holds 40, research recovery 3 rounds, seal ritual 4 rounds + sacrifice), resource allocation under time pressure, triage decisions (who to leave behind? VIPs vs. random civilians?), evacuation logistics, sacrifice mechanics (seal ritual requires PC void sacrifice, 50% success chance), rear guard combat while evacuating, absolute consequence (round 10 = station explodes). Tests underrepresented time-pressure decision-making, triage ethics, resource allocation, sacrifice choices, logistics management. Features heavy weapons (Shrike Cannon +6 DMG, Breach Hammer +7 DMG), pilot specialist (Pilot 6, Systems 5), ritualist with seal option (Astral Arts 6, Attunement 6). Hard deadline creates urgency unlike clock-based scenarios.
